_note: Best-effort SiteOrigin Page Builder 'panels_data' scaffold for the Single Book layout. Same caveat as home-page-layout.json — verify on a draft, rebuild live if import doesn't take. This is only needed if you want the single-book.php PHP layout overridden per-book via Page Builder; the PHP template already renders the full layout automatically for any book that has NOT been customized this way.
usage_note: The book_hero, description, characters, media, and gallery sections are already rendered automatically by single-book.php from the Pods fields (book_thumbnail, buy_links, book_description, book_characters, media_links, book_images) with no Page Builder needed. Only add a Page Builder layout to a specific book if an editor wants to hand-customize that one book's page beyond the standard template.
